summary: The recorded configuration-contract step has two saved-settings precedence defects. The focused tests pass, but a reviewer-only override can silently replace saved canonical choices.

outcomes.evidence: Review only; no implementation changes were made. The defects are in settings.overlay at lib/pr_review/settings.py:105.

checks: Ran `timeout 60s python -m unittest discover -s tests -p test_settings_slots.py`: 8 tests passed.
Ran `timeout 60s python -m unittest discover -s tests -p test_api.py -k 'setup_resolves_saved_and_pending_configuration_without_mutating_drafts'`: 1 test passed.
Ran `timeout 60s python -m unittest discover -s tests -p test_api.py -k 'saved_canonical_slots_survive_defaults_and_pending_load'`: 1 test passed.

Ran two bounded Python reproductions using settings.initial_settings, settings.from_manifest, settings.overlay, and settings.validate. They demonstrated loss of saved processing settings and distinct saved slot settings after reviewer-only overrides.

case_results.evidence: The focused settings suite passed default, preset, and explicit provider-model override coverage; effort values follow the same overlay path.
The focused settings suite passed single-reviewer and reversed mixed-provider normalization coverage.
The focused settings suite passed distinct-slot round trips for both duplicate-provider combinations.
The focused settings and API tests passed fresh implicit processing and same-request explicit processing scenarios. A separate saved-processing regression is listed in blocking.
The focused legacy-manifest and saved/pending API tests passed recorded-value precedence, historical defaults, explicit overrides, and manifest-preservation checks.

The saved canonical and pending-load API test passed with differing provisional defaults; the duplicate-slot test passed normalization round trips. A separate reviewer-only override regression is listed in blocking.
The focused catalog test passed valid duplicate slots and independent processing, and rejected unsupported slot and processing selections.
The focused settings suite passed malformed layered-choice and invalid reviewer, model, and effort rejection cases.

blocking: A reviewer-only override deletes an explicitly saved independent processing configuration. A saved Claude reviewer with Codex processing model `custom` and effort `low` becomes Claude processing with `opus` and `high` after overlaying `reviewers=['claude']`. Preserve the saved explicit processing choice unless processing itself is overridden.

A provider-based reviewer-only override discards saved canonical slot settings even when the providers are unchanged. Two saved Claude slots with distinct models and efforts both become the legacy `opus`/`high` values after overlaying `reviewers=['claude','claude']`. Preserve unaffected saved slot choices when applying provider-based overrides.
